cases.tsd: target site duplication (length not stated in abstract)
cases.mechanism_detail: Heterozygous truncated AluYa5 insertion (85-bp Alu fragment plus polyA and TSD) in APOB exon 3 introduces a frameshift/stop p.(Phe46Alafs*2) and also causes exon skipping giving p.(Lys41Serfs*2).
cases.quote: A functional study revealed that this MEI introduces a stop codon p.(Phe46Alafs*2) and additionally leads to p.(Lys41Serfs*2) due to an exon skipping.
